This coin is overstrike of official Thessalonican coin:
Thessalonica

obverse: head of Dionysos with ivy wreath right
goat standing right
ΘEΣΣA_ΛO / N_IK_HΣ
(NE) / ? other monograms
Sear #1466; BMC Macedonia p. 110, 10 - 16

Imitation coins from the Serdi region weren't meant to fool Macedonian traders as counterfeit but were minted as their own currency. This coin, an overstrike on a coin issued by a Macedonian authority, is evidence of this emulative and transformative purpose.

images.filename: Bulgaria Bulgaria-0546 - Church of St Nicholas the Miracle-Maker (7390227698).jpg
images.caption:
Church of St Nicholas the Miracle-Maker, was built on the site of the Saray Mosque, which was destroyed in 1882, after the liberation of Bulgaria by Russia from the Ottoman Empire. The five domes are coated with gold. The bells were donated by Emperor Nicholas II.
Construction began in 1907 and the church was consecrated in 1914.
images.alt:
Church of St Nicholas the Miracle-Maker, was built on the site of the Saray Mosque, which was destroyed in 1882, after the liberation of Bulgaria by Russia from the Ottoman Empire. The five domes are coated with gold. The bells were donated by Emperor Nicholas II.
Construction began in 1907 and the church was consecrated in 1914.
